Title: Faryaal Khalid, Aisha Naz Ansari, Dr Sadia Bhutta
Description:
​Dr Sadia Bhutta is working as an Associate Professor at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan. Her research interests include classroom practice, learning outcomes, and quantitative research methods.

Faryaal Khalid holds a Master's degree in English Linguistics from the University of Karachi and is currently pursuing her MPhil at Iqra University. She has taught as visiting faculty for several years and has previously served as the Academic Support and Content Specialist and the Assistant Manager for the B.Ed. programme at the AKU-IED. Currently, she works as a Research Specialist at AKU-IED where she is involved in a large-scale education project aimed at improving learning outcomes for communities across Pakistan.

Aisha Naz Ansari is a Research Specialist at the Aga Khan University, Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan, and an Associate Fellow of Advance HE, UK. She is a member of the ESIC Working Group on AI for Evidence Synthesis under Cochrane Collaborations. She has conducted and published research in the areas of educational technology, teacher education, AI in higher education, systematic reviews, public-private partnerships, and classroom teaching and learning. To date, she has 30 research publications to her credit.​

Description:
​About Authors

Wadhwani Nimarta

Nimarta is a M.Phil graduate and a budding researcher working as a Senior Research Assistant in a nation-wide study funded by DARE-RC at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). She holds an experience of working on similar funded projects. Her own research area focuses on School structures and Teacher Agency.

Khadija Gul

Khadija Gul is a Senior Research Assistant at the Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). Her research primarily focuses on education policy, with a particular emphasis on the implementation of the school Clustering Policy. Her other areas of interest include educational policy, mental health, and English language and literature teaching. She also writes on these areas as blogs and newspaper columns.

Afsar Uddin

Afsar Uddin is an MPhil graduate from the Aga Khan University – Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). He currently serves as a principal with the Elementary and Secondary Education Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, based in Chitral. Alongside his administrative role, Afsar is also associated with the Aga Khan University as a part-time research associate, contributing to a research project focused on gender-based violence in Pakistani colleges. His professional interests lie in educational leadership, equity, and community-centered school development.

Sadia Bhutta

Dr Sadia Bhutta is working as an Associate Professor at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan. Her research interests include classroom practice, learning outcomes, and quantitative research methods.
